study type: retrospective cohort study with prospectively collected data
cohort: The cohort consists of 460 women undergoing laparoscopic endometriosis surgery at a single tertiary referral center.
finding: The prevalence of appendiceal endometriosis was 2.8%, and it was significantly associated with a 4.1-fold higher risk of ovarian endometriosis and a 4.4-fold higher risk of bladder endometriosis, but a 0.1-fold risk of concomitant uterosacral ligament endometriosis.
